Title: Previous Distributions finds a distribution by its reference
Step Expected: The list and its search form are shown.

Step Action: Type the reference of the row in Distribution Reference.

Step Expected: A row with the reference and scheme code is listed.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: Previous Distributions finds distributions by scheme code
Step Expected: The list and its search form are shown.

Step Action: Type the scheme code of the row in Scheme Code.

Step Expected: A row with the reference and scheme code is listed.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: View opens the results of a previous distribution

Step Action: Click View on the row with the reference.
Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: View opens the report of a distribution

Step Action: Click View on the row with the reference.
Read the main heading and text.
Step Expected: The h1 is View reports and the text shows the reference.
GENERATE PDF and BACK are shown.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: BACK on a results or report page returns to its list
Step Action: Open the list in the row (Previous Distributions or Reports).
Click View on the first row.
Step Expected: The results or report page opens.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
